# PVBiz

> PVBiz is a South African solar monitoring and fleet-management platform. It connects to 14+ inverter brands and platforms and gives homeowners, businesses and solar installers one place for live monitoring, smart alerts, forecasting, reporting, tariff and savings analysis, and inverter automation.

PVBiz Pty Ltd, South Africa. Contact: info@pvbiz.co.za, +27 61 546 7165.

## Products

- [PVBiz for homeowners and businesses](https://www.pvbiz.co.za/homeowners/): monitor your own solar plants, get alerts by push, email and Telegram (WhatsApp as an add-on), see forecasts and reports. 7-day free trial, no card needed; R55/month or R549/year for up to 2 solar plants.
- [PVBiz for commercial and asset owners](https://www.pvbiz.co.za/commercial/): savings against the real tariff, PPA tracking, REC and carbon tracking, scheduled reports.
- [PVBiz Installer Platform](https://www.pvbiz.co.za/installers/): multi-brand fleet monitoring for solar installers and O&M teams, with alerting, client reporting, tariff modelling, PPA and savings calculations. Over 1,000 sites and 32 MWp under management. Priced per fleet; book a demo.
- [Pricing](https://www.pvbiz.co.za/pricing/): public prices in ZAR, USD, EUR and GBP (fixed per currency, not converted).
- Mobile apps: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/za/app/pvbiz/id6742043415), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pvbiz).
- Web app: https://app.pvbiz.co.za

## How it connects

Read-only access. You share your plant with PVBiz on your inverter's own cloud platform (for example, share a Sunsynk plant with admin@pvbiz.co.za, or authorise PVBiz as a business in Solarman/Deye). No hardware is installed.
